reason: I already paid for salon software once and my girls never touched it, so it got cancelled. My register and counting the drawer myself every night works, and I don't want to pay ₹4,999 again to learn the same lesson.
objection: Half my customers won't give their mobile number, and my staff won't take a selfie and type numbers for every walk-in when the shop is busy. Then the reminders and the cash check are useless and I'm paying ₹999 a month for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If they took the setup money only after a month where my staff actually billed every customer in it, and I could see that the drawer figure matched my own count.
